name: GrandDrive 3D India
prompt: Build a 3D Village & Highway Vehicle Driving Game named GrandDrive 3D India using TITAN_3D_GAME_REACTOR (FactoryGame.startVillageRace, FactoryGame.startSpinWheel, FactoryGame.isUnlocked, FactoryGame.unlockVehicle) with fiery crimson-red, nitro-gold, and electric-blue 3D dark-glass styling (NO real-money gambling; virtual coins & skill XP only). 1. Tab 1 (Gaming Lobby - #view-1): - Top 3D Driver Hero Card (.sf-hero-card) showing Player Name (u.full_name), Driver Rank, Total Coins, "3D HIGHWAY LIVE" badge, and "Claim +50 Daily Fuel" calling FactoryPro.claimDailyBonus(). - 2-Column Stat Grid (.sf-stat-grid) showing Total Races and High Score. - Horizontal Scroll 3D Garage (.sf-hscroll with .sf-hcard cards) of 5 Vehicles using FactoryGame.isUnlocked(id, free): 1) "City Sedan Car" (id: "car", 0 Coins, free=true) 2) "Desi Bullet Bike" (id: "bike", 80 Coins) 3) "Express Highway Bus" (id: "bus", 150 Coins) 4) "Heavy Cargo Truck" (id: "truck", 300 Coins) 5) "Turbo Sports Supercar" (id: "supercar", 500 Coins) - Tapping an unlocked vehicle launches FactoryGame.startVillageRace(vehicleName, accentColor) with full-screen 3D village huts, trees, river bridge, 3 Camera Angles (CAM), and Walk/Drive mode! Tapping a locked vehicle opens Detail Page with "Unlock Vehicle" calling FactoryGame.unlockVehicle(id, cost, vehicleName). - Below garage, add a big "Lucky Pit-Stop Spin Wheel" button calling FactoryGame.startSpinWheel("Pit-Stop Bonus Wheel"). 2. Tab 2 (Custom Cup - #view-2): - "Create Custom 3D Highway Cup" form (Cup Name, Vehicle: Car/Bike/Bus/Truck/Supercar, Target Score) saving via FactoryDB.saveItem("race", ...) + 2 tiles (.sf-action-tile): "Toggle 3D Sound" (FactorySound.toggle()) and "VIP Pro Garage" (FactoryPro.showProModal("VIP Pro Garage", "Rs. 99 / mo")). 3. Tab 3 (Leaderboard - #view-3): - Live 3D Racer Leaderboard & Race History from FactoryDB.getItems("race") and FactoryDB.getTransactions() rendered as colorful .sf-list-row cards. Tapping any row opens FactoryNav.openDetail(...) with scorecard and Back button. 4. Tab 4 (Driver Profile - #view-4): - Shows Driver Name, Total Coins, "Invite Crew +25 Coins" (FactoryEngine.openReferShare()), "3D Controls Guide" (FactoryEngine.openTutorial()), "Download Driver License PDF" (FactoryUI.downloadPDF()), and "Reset Session" (FactoryNav.logout()). - Define clean text-only window.APP_TUTORIAL_HTML (NO tags) using template backticks explaining 3D Camera Angles (CAM), Walk/Drive Mode, Car/Bus/Truck Unlocking, and Pit-Stop Spin.
